sections.heading: Published
paragraphs: 02:29 UTC on 18 September 2026. Status investigating. Affected region EU. Affected component webhook delivery.

sections.heading: Message
paragraphs: Some EU webhook deliveries are taking longer than expected. Device readings are being received and remain visible in Fleet Console. Engineers are investigating the delivery queue. We will post another update by 02:59 UTC.
